question: A thin rod of length $L$ is placed along the x-axis with one end at the origin ($x=0$) and the other at $x=L$. The rod carries a non-uniform linear charge density given by $λ(x) = αx$, where $α$ is a positive constant. A point charge $-Q$ is placed on the x-axis at $x = 2L$. Find the magnitude of the net electrostatic force exerted by the rod on the point charge $-Q$.
